name: @forest/host
description: The Forest Foundation's host: forest/records' reference host, unchanged, run with this service's policy: a file per folder, blobs on disk or in a bucket, every write paid in credits it sells (one cent each, one a started megabyte of a write) from a folder's balance, a registry lookup for inboxes that take messages from one issuer's rows, and senders' records read, from public addresses only, to take a message key's messages.
